idea-plugin.name: Jira Flow - Issues, Git Branches & Time Tracker
idea-plugin.description:
Jira Flow - Issues, Git Branches & Time Tracker is an integrated IntelliJ IDEA tool window for browsing Jira Server & Data Center issues, automating Git task branch workflows, tracking time with meeting-aware timers, and syncing upcoming Microsoft Teams / Outlook meetings directly inside your IDE.

Key Features

  • Rich Jira Issue Browser & Filtering: Search issues with custom JQL queries and quick filters (Assigned to Me, Reported by Me, Recently Updated, Active Sprint), inspect subtasks and progress bars, transition workflow statuses, and read or reply to issue comments.
  • Git Branch Automation: Automatically detects existing local and remote-tracking branches linked to an issue (or its parent ticket) and offers one-click creation and checkout of standardized feature/ or bugfix/ branches when starting a timer.
  • Time Tracker & Staged Worklogs: Built-in live stopwatch with human-readable Xh Ym durations, customizable commit message templates ({issueKey}: {summary}), and a dedicated Staged tab where time from both Tracker and Meetings is queued for review and inline editing before submitting all entries to Jira in one click.
  • Microsoft Teams & Outlook Meetings Sync: Sync upcoming calendar events via a published Outlook/Teams ICS feed URL (no Azure admin approval needed) or Microsoft Graph API token, link single or recurring meetings to Jira tickets, and stage meeting durations in one click.
  • Smart Meeting Collision Pause & Resume: Automatically pauses any active task timer when a scheduled meeting starts and resumes tracking your task as soon as the meeting ends.
  • Worldwide Timezone Alignment & Secure Credentials: Automatically aligns logged worklog timestamps with your Jira Server's timezone (/rest/api/2/serverInfo) across all timezones, and stores multiple Jira Server/Data Center profiles securely in IntelliJ Password Safe.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.6

  • Fixed worklog timezone alignment on Jira Servers running in UTC or a different JVM offset by automatically detecting the server's offset via /rest/api/2/serverInfo, so logged start times match in both Jira Web UI and the plugin worldwide.

0.1.5

  • Added Staged worklogs tab: time from both Tracker and Meetings is now staged for review and inline editing (duration, start time, and description) with a single Log All to Jira action.
  • Formatted all time spent displays in hours and minutes (e.g. 5h 23m instead of raw minutes like 323m).
  • Fixed worldwide Jira worklog timezone alignment by matching the authenticated Jira user's profile timezone (/rest/api/2/myself) so logged times appear accurately in Jira Web UI across all timezones.

0.1.4

  • Fixed worklog, meeting, and comment timestamps to always use the OS/JVM system timezone (preventing 1-hour UTC/DST offsets when JCEF defaults to UTC).

0.1.3

  • Added Meetings tab to sync upcoming Microsoft Teams / Outlook meetings via ICS Calendar Feed URL or Microsoft Graph API.
  • Added persistent single and recurring meeting-to-Jira ticket mapping with one-click meeting worklog submission.
  • Added automatic task timer pause during colliding meetings and automatic resumption when the meeting ends.
  • Expanded compatibility across IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 through 2026.x+.
